call_points.text: Management expects total loan book to cross ₹1 lakh Cr in FY27 with retail loan book growing 18-20%.
Company expects ₹200 Cr to ₹250 Cr recoveries from written-off pool in FY27.
Management aims to continue focusing on high-yielding Emerging Markets and Affordable segments.
Branch network expanded to 393 locations, with 80% focused on Affordable and Emerging Markets.
Cost of borrowing improved to 7.35% in Q4 FY26 from 7.50% in Q3 FY26.
Board recommended a dividend of ₹8 per equity share for FY26.

guidance.statement: Loan book to cross more than ₹1 lakh Cr in FY27
Retail loan book projected to grow between 18% to 20%
NIM would be in the range of 3.55% to 3.65%
ROA would be in the range of 2.4% to 2.5%
Overall loan book growth of 18-20% for FY27
Affordable loan book growth of 50-60% for FY27
Affordable and Emerging share of book to reach 45% by end FY27 and about 50% in FY28
ROA around 2.4% for FY27, settling to 2.3-2.35% longer term
Credit cost to remain negative for FY27 on continued recoveries
Construction finance portfolio restricted to 3% of overall book in FY27
NIM to improve from H2FY27 onwards as margins have bottomed

entities.name: PHFL Home Loans and Services Limited

industry: Financial Services > Finance > Housing Finance Company

operating_notes.text: Assets Under Management reached ₹90,921 crore as of FY26.
Retail disbursements reached an all-time high of ₹9,020 Cr in Q4 FY26.
Affordable and Emerging Markets segments contribute 40% of the retail loan asset portfolio.
Recovered ₹332 Cr in FY26 from the total written-off pool.
Retail loan book reached ₹86,946 Cr and total loan book stood at ₹87,347 Cr as of March 31, 2026.
Management expects ₹200-250 Cr recovery from written-off pool in FY27.
Affordable loan book (Roshni) stood at ₹8,153 Cr as of March 31, 2026.
Retail loan book comprises 99.5% of the total portfolio as of March 31, 2026.
Written-off retail pool stands at around ₹340 Cr after ₹67 Cr of Q1FY27 recoveries.
BT-in fell to 4.4% of sourcing in Q1FY27 from 5% a year ago; Affordable BT-in fell to 3.4% from 10.5%.
Branch network at 404 after adding 12 branches in the quarter; 100% of fresh disbursals run on the new SFDC LOS.
Issued ₹253.65 Cr 5-year secured NCDs Series LXXIX at 8.4552% coupon, redeemable October 23, 2031.
